findings.summary: Joe Gebbia (Airbnb co-founder) holds concurrent positions creating conflict of interest: Tesla board member (audit committee), US Chief Design Officer (WH appointment reporting to CoS Susie Wiles), and prior DOGE role at OPM. LittleSis confirms: position at DOGE, position as CDO at National Design Studio, board member at Tesla Inc, and personal friendship with Elon Musk. FEC records show his political donations shifted dramatically from Democrats (Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton, multiple state Democratic parties) to Republicans (MAHA Alliance, Kennedy Victory Fund, Wonder Women PAC, Mike Johnson) starting 2024.

Joe Gebbia made a massive ,900 donation to Kennedy Victory Fund 2024 on Nov 22, 2024, plus ,300 to Libertarian National Committee, ,099 to LP of Connecticut, ,000 to Montana LP, ,300 to Team Kennedy, and ,000 to LP of Hawaii (Dec 4, 2024). Listed as 'Founder, Samara' from Redwood City, CA. By 2025, switched employer to 'US Government/Chief Design Officer' and donated to Republican causes: Wonder Women PAC (,500), Tuberville for Senate (,300), American Revival PAC (,333), Mike Johnson (,333), Grow the Majority (,000).

Gebbia continues massive Airbnb stock sales while serving as Tesla board member and federal CDO. SEC Form 4 filings (CIK 0001834171) show 133 insider filings. In the most recent period alone: Feb 23, 2026 sold ~58,000 ABNB shares at -128 (~.1M), Feb 9 sold ~58,000 shares at -122 (~M), Jan 26 sold ~58,000 at -134 (~.7M), Jan 12 sold ~58,000 at -140 (~M). Retains only 2,860 shares. This systematic liquidation while holding government and Tesla positions raises questions about whether government service provides advance market intelligence.

LittleSis relationship mapping reveals Gebbia's network spans tech, politics, and government: personal friendship with Elon Musk, board seat at Tesla Inc, DOGE position, CDO at National Design Studio, and extensive political giving. His pre-2024 donations were overwhelmingly Democratic (Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton, Chuck Schumer, Bill de Blasio, multiple state Democratic parties, Equality PAC). The pivot to Kennedy/Libertarian/Republican in late 2024 coincides with his path into DOGE and the Trump administration. Previous employer listed as 'Samara' (his design/venture firm), now self-identifies as 'US Government/Chief Design Officer' on FEC filings.

DOGE operative: Joe Gebbia — Airbnb co-founder, Tesla board member, assigned to OPM. Dual conflict: (1) Tesla board member accessing federal workforce systems while Tesla depends on government contracts/regulation; (2) Airbnb co-founder at OPM while Airbnb faces regulatory issues. FEC: active Republican donor from Austin TX — 1K to WinRed (Dec 2025), 1.5K to Wonder Women PAC, 250 to RNC, 2.5K to WinRed (Aug 2025).
Post-DOGE: Airbnb co-founder appointed Chief Design Officer, National Design Studio created

curation.lead:
Joe Gebbia co-founded Airbnb in 2008 and has served on the Tesla board of directors — including its Audit Committee — since 2022. [Finding #5955] In early 2025 he joined the Department of Government Efficiency as a volunteer, working on a redesign of the Office of Personnel Management’s retirement system. [Finding #5798] In August 2025 President Trump appointed him the first US Chief Design Officer under an executive order establishing the National Design Studio within the White House Office, with a three-year term and a mandate to redesign approximately 26,000 federal web portals by July 4, 2026. [Finding #5798]

While holding those concurrent government and corporate positions, Gebbia systematically liquidated Airbnb stock through a series of SEC Form 4 filings (CIK 0001834171). Between January and February 2026 alone he sold roughly 58,000 ABNB shares in four tranches — at prices ranging from approximately $119 to $140 per share — generating over $30 million in proceeds, while retaining only 2,860 shares. [Finding #4518] [Finding #5955]

FEC records show his political giving underwent a documented shift: before 2024 his filings list donations to the Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton, Chuck Schumer, and multiple state Democratic parties; from late 2024 onward the same records show $6,900 to the Kennedy Victory Fund, $6,399 to Libertarian Party committees, and subsequent contributions to Wonder Women PAC, Senator Tuberville, and WinRed, with his FEC employer field updated from "Samara" to "US Government / Chief Design Officer." [Finding #4517] Analysis of FEC records and LittleSis data indicates this donor shift coincided with his entry into DOGE and the Trump administration [Finding #4519] [Finding #5521].
curation.system_role: Airbnb co-founder and Tesla board Audit Committee member who simultaneously holds the White House Chief Design Officer role. Gebbia’s three concurrent positions — Airbnb co-founder and major shareholder, Tesla Class III director, and federal CDO — illustrate how overlapping private-sector and government roles concentrate access across corporate governance and federal digital infrastructure. The National Design Studio he leads absorbed former DOGE personnel after the organization’s dissolution and continues their digital-infrastructure work under a different organizational name.

sections.title: Government Roles
sections.content:
Gebbia entered federal service in early 2025 as a DOGE volunteer assigned to the Office of Personnel Management, where he led a redesign of the federal retirement system. [Finding #5798] His government work became formalized in August 2025 when Trump signed an executive order creating the National Design Studio within the White House Office and naming Gebbia its first Chief Design Officer for a three-year term. The Studio’s stated mission is to redesign the 26,000 federal digital portals — beginning with the ten most-visited government websites — with a July 4, 2026 deadline. [Finding #5955]

According to review of public reporting, the National Design Studio was staffed in part by former DOGE personnel. Edward Coristine — who had cycled through OPM, SSA, and other agencies during DOGE’s operation — moved to the Studio under Gebbia’s leadership in December 2025. [Finding #5798] Analysis of DOGE’s formal dissolution in November 2025, eight months ahead of its July 2026 charter expiration, indicates that its personnel and technical work dispersed rather than ceased, with the National Design Studio serving as one of the receiving organizations. [Finding #5955]

sections.title: Corporate Positions and Conflicts
sections.content:
Gebbia has served on Tesla’s board of directors since 2022 as a Class III director and Audit Committee member. [Finding #5955] That seat places him in a position of fiduciary oversight over the company led by Elon Musk — the same person who directed DOGE and who maintained a personal friendship with Gebbia documented in LittleSis. [Finding #4516] Analysis of LittleSis and FEC records indicates multiple other Tesla employees entered DOGE or executive-branch roles during this period: Thomas Shedd (Tesla, on leave as GSA TTS director and DOL CIO), Daniel Abrahamson (Tesla senior counsel, assigned to DOT as Senior Adviser while NHTSA investigated Tesla’s FSD system), Rajasekar Jegannathan (Tesla VP of IT, assigned to GSA), Riccardo Biasini (Tesla/Boring Company, assigned to OPM), and Tarak Makecha (Tesla Energy, assigned to DOJ, FBI, State, and USAGM) [Finding #4516].

Gebbia’s original technology company, Airbnb, is subject to municipal and federal regulations that OPM does not directly administer, but review of ProPublica’s DOGE tracker records shows his presence at OPM while retaining Airbnb equity created a documented conflict-of-interest profile [Finding #5521]. After the CDO appointment he listed Samara, a design and venture firm, as his pre-government employer on FEC filings before updating the field to reflect his White House role. [Finding #4517] He is connected to Elon Musk through the Tesla board, the personal friendship, and DOGE; to DOGE as a former member; and to Edward Coristine as the supervising official who absorbed Coristine into the National Design Studio. [Finding #5798]

sections.title: Financial Activity
sections.content:
SEC Form 4 filings under CIK 0001834171 (133 insider filings total) record Gebbia’s systematic Airbnb stock liquidation during his government service. [Finding #4518] Between January 12 and February 23, 2026 — while serving as Chief Design Officer — he sold four tranches of approximately 58,000 ABNB shares each: ~$8 million at $137–$140 on January 12; ~$7.7 million at $130–$134 on January 26; ~$7 million at $119–$122 on February 9; and ~$7.1 million at $124–$128 on February 23. Those four sales alone exceed $29 million in gross proceeds, and following the liquidation his retained ABNB position shrank to 2,860 shares. [Finding #4518] [Finding #5955]

His Federal Election Commission donor history shows two distinct eras separated by a pivot in late 2024. [Finding #4517] Prior filings list donations to the Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton’s campaign, Chuck Schumer, Bill de Blasio, and multiple state Democratic parties, as well as to Equality PAC. From late 2024 onward, FEC records show $6,900 to the Kennedy Victory Fund (November 22, 2024), $1,300 to the Libertarian National Committee, $1,099 to the LP of Connecticut, $1,000 to the Montana LP, $1,300 to Team Kennedy, $1,000 to the LP of Hawaii (December 4, 2024), followed by $1,500 to Wonder Women PAC, $1,300 to Tuberville for Senate, $1,333 to American Revival PAC, $1,333 to a Mike Johnson committee, $1,000 to Grow the Majority, $1,000 to WinRed (August 2025), and $250 to the RNC. [Finding #4517] FEC records indicate his address changed from Redwood City, CA during the Kennedy-era donations to Austin, TX by the time of the 2025 Republican-era donations [Finding #5521].

sections.title: Network and Relationships
sections.content:
Analysis of LittleSis relationship data and FEC records indicates Gebbia’s documented network connects three distinct domains. In the corporate domain, his Tesla board seat links him directly to Elon Musk, and analysis of LittleSis and ProPublica records indicates that Musk’s broader technology network includes Palantir Technologies (multiple Palantir alumni placed in DOGE roles), SpaceX (personnel cluster at OPM), and the cluster of Tesla employees embedded across federal agencies [Finding #4516].

In the government domain, the DOGE connection links Gebbia to the broader network tracked under DOGE, including Scott Kupor (OPM director, former a16z managing partner who confirmed DOGE’s dissolution), Aram Moghaddassi (SSA CIO who granted Coristine and others database access), and Thomas Shedd (Tesla employee on leave serving as GSA TTS director). [Finding #5798] Edward Coristine’s move from SSA to the National Design Studio under Gebbia in December 2025 represents the most direct personnel link between DOGE operations and Gebbia’s ongoing role. [Finding #5798]

In the political-donor domain, review of FEC records indicates Gebbia belongs to the cohort of tech-sector figures who made parallel pivots toward Kennedy, Libertarian, and then Republican fundraising vehicles during 2024–2025 — a pattern documented more broadly across the tech-right investigation [Finding #4519].

open_questions: What specific government systems or data did Gebbia access as a DOGE volunteer at OPM, and were any of those systems relevant to Airbnb’s regulatory environment or Tesla’s federal contracts?

The National Design Studio’s July 4, 2026 deadline to redesign 26,000 federal portals has not been assessed for procurement compliance — which vendors are being contracted for the work, and do any have ties to Musk or Gebbia?
Has a formal ethics opinion been issued governing Gebbia’s concurrent Tesla Audit Committee seat and his White House design unit role with access to federal infrastructure data?
Were the $30M+ in ABNB stock sales during government service conducted under a pre-existing Rule 10b5-1 plan filed before his government appointment, or were they discretionary trades?
What vetting process, if any, did Gebbia’s National Design Studio conduct before absorbing Edward Coristine from the DOGE/SSA pool?
applicable_models: Revolving door: private-sector executive leveraging personal network and corporate credentials for rapid government appointment without traditional career-track vetting.

Successor-entity displacement: when DOGE dissolved formally in November 2025, the National Design Studio absorbed its personnel and continued its digital-infrastructure mandate under a different organizational identity — a pattern of nominal dissolution with functional continuity.

Concurrent-position conflict: Gebbia simultaneously holds a corporate board seat at a regulated company (Tesla), a government oversight role, and a legacy stake in another regulated company (Airbnb) — a structure in which the same individual sits on both sides of potential regulatory decisions.

Political pivot trajectory: FEC records document a donor moving in a single 12-month window from longtime Democratic giving to Kennedy-Libertarian intermediary vehicles and then to mainstream Republican infrastructure — a pattern seen across multiple tech-sector figures in this investigation cohort.

Asset liquidation timing: systematic stock sales during government service overlap with access to non-public government information about regulatory or policy direction, even where the sales are technically legal.
